verdict.rationale: Mailchimp publishes Marketing and Transactional API references that document endpoints, such as GET https://api.mailchimp.com/3.0/, adding audience contacts and sending campaigns. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in the browser. missing for 10: any evidence of a try-it/interactive console, runnable code examples or sandbox execution in the docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
